intro.before: For all the little moments that became

memoriesHeading.kicker: A few pages from my favorite story
memoriesHeading.title: The moments I keep
memoriesHeading.description: These are just a few of the special moments we had, sobrang dami hindi ko kaya ilagay lahat HAHAHA

memories.title: A day worth keeping
memories.text: Remember this night? I think so much of what to do for the day that we planned this out late, tumambay lang saglit at kumain, pero nakalibre ng treehouse kase hindi natin alam na may bayad pala yun HAHAHA
memories.caption: That night trip might not have been longer but I got to spend it with you, and that's what important to me
memories.alt: A couple smiling together outdoors near greenery

memories.title: Camp lebana Again
memories.text: Next day after our supposedly failed trip, we came back, this time we had so much fun. We filmed ourselves playing, and I was so happy seeing you enjoy our time.
memories.caption: We were having fun that time quickly passed, Time passes by so fast when you're with someone special.
memories.alt: A couple taking a smiling selfie together at night

memories.title: Nothing on the calendar
memories.text: The best plans are sometimes no plans at all. A slow afternoon with you has a way of making the whole world feel softer around the edges.
memories.caption: Add a private in-joke, a favorite café, or the story behind this day.
memories.alt: A couple smiling together in front of a colorful outdoor building

memories.title: The view was worth it
memories.text: Fresh air, mountain views, and a road that gave us another reason to stop and take it all in.
memories.caption: The fourth page, with the new photo.
memories.alt: A woman smiling on a motorcycle with a mountain view behind her

memories.title: Our kind of silly
memories.text: No big occasion needed. Just the two of us finding another reason to laugh together.
memories.caption: The moments that feel most like us.
memories.alt: A couple posing together in a shop

memories.title: Right where I belong
memories.text: Every familiar smile reminds me how lucky I am to share these days with you.
memories.caption: One more little moment I want to keep.
memories.alt: A couple smiling and posing together in a shop

memories.title: A memory to revisit
memories.text: Some places stay with us because of the person standing beside us. This is one I will always want to revisit.
memories.caption: A beautiful day, saved right here.
memories.alt: A couple smiling together in a close-up selfie

memories.title: More memories to come
memories.text: This little book is still growing. There are so many more ordinary, wonderful days I cannot wait to share with you.
memories.caption: Add your own story here whenever a new favorite moment happens.

letter.paragraph: Another year of you in this world is a gift to everyone lucky enough to know you. Thank you for your kind heart, your bright laugh, and the way you make even the quietest moments feel like home. I hope this next trip around the sun brings you all the tenderness and joy you give so freely to everyone around you.
